meta.title: Reverse auction (tick 1): keep the same price

steps.note: Open the prepared live reverse auction on the buyer's Responses screen.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live reverse auction and its existing bid for revision.

args.because: Quoted price difference must be greater than the tick size

steps.note: Resubmit the unchanged price and require Procol to refuse it with the tick-size message.
Verify the buyer still sees the single original direct vendor response after the refused revision.
Open the buyer's Master QCS view for the same prepared event.
Verify the Master QCS still contains the original real vendor column and no extra response.
